name: Premier Plastics
old_description: Designed for Business - Engineered for Flexibility - Focused on Customer Satisfaction
about:
Premier Plastics operates from Omaha, Nebraska, where President Ted Sondgeroth leads the company. The business focuses on business-to-business injection molding services, offering flexible, adaptable, and scalable solutions for customers ranging from those with no molding experience to large companies with their own in-house molding operations.

The company’s core competency is injection molding, part design, and tooling, supported by an in-house engineering team. Services span custom molding, insert molding, tight-tolerance and difficult-to-mold parts, product development, prototyping, and secondary operations including assembly and packaging. The plant runs 24/7, and the firm also provides warehousing, vendor-managed inventory, just-in-time support, order fulfillment, and drop shipping.

Premier Plastics serves a broad range of industries, including automotive, agricultural, aviation, construction and home improvement, energy, medical, transportation, utilities, sports and recreation, toys and learning products, and health care. Customers are typically OEMs and other businesses seeking custom molded components.

The company emphasizes direct access to decision-makers: President Ted Sondgeroth personally evaluates customer needs, aiming to eliminate lengthy quote cycles and bureaucratic handoffs. This approach, combined with in-house engineering and 24/7 production, is presented as the primary differentiator.
